definitions.name: strategy_subscriptions
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `strategy_subscriptions` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `trading_account_id` int NOT NULL,
  `strategy_id` int NOT NULL,
  `risk_profile_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `symbols_json` text,
  `execution_enabled` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `memory_mode` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shared',
  `conflicting_strategy_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_deleted` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `schedule_enabled` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `schedule_timezone` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'terminal_server',
  `schedule_weekdays_json` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '[1,2,3,4,5]',
  `schedule_windows_json` text,
  `outside_window_behavior` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pause_all',
  `take_profit_mode` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ai_recommended',
  `active_execution_user_key` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`execution_enabled` = 1) and (`is_deleted` = 0)) then `user_id` else NULL end)) STORED /*!80023 INVISIBLE */,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_subscription_active_execution_user` (`active_execution_user_key`),
  KEY `idx_ss_user_strategy` (`user_id`,`strategy_id`,`is_deleted`),
  KEY `idx_ss_account_strategy` (`trading_account_id`,`strategy_id`,`is_deleted`),
  KEY `idx_ss_account_exec` (`trading_account_id`,`execution_enabled`,`is_deleted`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=6 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

definitions.name: trading_accounts
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `trading_accounts` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `broker_server` varchar(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `login_account` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `nickname` varchar(100) DEFAULT '',
  `margin_mode` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `review_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `observe_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `is_deleted` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `observed_until` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `identity_verified_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `first_verified_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `anomaly_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_trading_account_identity` (`user_id`,`broker_server`,`login_account`),
  KEY `idx_ta_user` (`user_id`,`is_deleted`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

definitions.name: users
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `uid` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email_verified` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `auth_method` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `nickname` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `avatar` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `role` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
  `plan` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free',
  `plan_period` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `plan_expires_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_username` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_chat_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_group_status` varchar(50) DEFAULT '',
  `telegram_bot_started_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_joined_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_last_invite_sent_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `referral_code` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `referral_credit` decimal(20,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `referred_by` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_seen_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `bridge_heartbeat` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (now(3)),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (now(3)),
  `phone` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone_verified` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `changelog_seen_version` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `plan_source` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `deletion_status` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `last_seen_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `profile_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uid` (`uid`),
  UNIQUE KEY `referral_code` (`referral_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_users_phone` (`phone`),
  KEY `idx_users_last_seen` (`last_seen_at`),
  KEY `idx_users_deletion_status` (`deletion_status`,`deleted_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=31 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
